name: 09_duct
note: This setup used to end at `g.lookOpen(r, ...)` with the result dropped — lookOpen is a query, so the shot was never posed and photographed the spawn. The hand-written fix that replaced it was also wrong: g.world.spawn is an ARRAY (lookOpen indexes pos[0]/pos[2]), so `r.x` was undefined and the camera went to NaN. g.lookAtOpen takes either form and poses from the position it actually found.
